verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so team assignment and rule-based routing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only label management, read/unread marking, and AI auto-categorization. Nothing shows assigning conversations to teammates or user-defined routing rules that make ownership explicit, and labels and auto-categorization are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
